The '''Nelfrus system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Elrood sector/Legends|Elrood sector]],<ref name="EAOC" /> a part of the [[Metharian Nebula Territories]] region<ref name="PotG3" /> of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nelfrus]].<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|369|Nelfrus}}</ref>
